claims.content: The C2 JU terminates the reporting of surveillance tracks by transmitting a drop track message when the track is no longer valid or responsibility is relinquished, and systems purge remote track data automatically when updates cease or specific criteria are met.

goal.raw_text: The C2 JU terminates the reporting of surveillance tracks by transmitting a drop track message when the track is no longer valid or responsibility is relinquished, and systems purge remote track data automatically when updates cease or specific criteria are met.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU currently has R² (responsibility) for the surveillance track being terminated.
The surveillance track is no longer valid, or the C2 JU is relinquishing responsibility to another JU.
For remote tracks, the system has not received further updates and may need to purge based on a specific time interval if no drop track message is received.
The system has the capability to automatically purge remote tracks after a specified time interval has elapsed since the last report.

The C2 JU transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) drop track message when it ceases reporting a surveillance track for which it currently has responsibility (R²), such as when the track is no longer valid or responsibility is relinquished to another JU.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) drop track message when it ceases reporting a surveillance track for which it currently has responsibility (R²), such as when the track is no longer valid or responsibility is relinquished to another JU.

claims.content: The C2 JU transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message when it ceases reporting a surveillance track for which it currently has responsibility (R²), except in cases where responsibility is relinquished to another JU or the track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN.
For NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs, the C2 JU transmits a J7.0 (ACT=0) message at the time of deactivation.
If a system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and receives no further updates on a remote track, the system automatically purges those tracks after a specific system-selected time interval.
DATUMS (DRT = 4) are not purged automatically.
When a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R² to another JU, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
When a track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
For NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs, a J7.0 (ACT=0) message shall be transmitted at time of deactivation, regardless of other conditions.
A J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R² to another JU.
A J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted when a track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN.
DATUMS (DRT = 4) shall not be purged automatically even if no further updates are received.
The JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a remote track/point that has been automatically purged after a specified time interval.
Under conditions where a system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and receives no further updates on a remote track, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted by the purging system.

The C2 JU has transmitted a J7.0 (ACT = 0) drop track message when ceasing to report a surveillance track for which it had R² responsibility, except when relinquishing R² to another JU or when the track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN.
For NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs, a J7.0 (ACT=0) message has been transmitted at the time of deactivation.

Remote tracks (DRT = 0-3) have been automatically purged by systems after a specific system-selected time interval elapsed since the last report, in cases where no J7.0 (ACT = 0) message was received and no further updates were received.
DATUMS (DRT = 4) have not been automatically purged even if no further updates were received.
No J7.0 (ACT = 0) message has been transmitted by a system on a remote track/point that was automatically purged after the specified time interval.

For ballistic missile tracks, a J7.0 message with Track Management Action field set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) has been transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a ballistic missile track for which it had R², except when relinquishing R² to another JU.
